issue_request: FHIR-48769 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request for R6 asking that Device.biologicalSourceEvent, Device.manufactureDate, Device.expirationDate, Device.lotNumber, and Device.serialNumber descriptions identify them as production identifiers for UDI traceability.
initial_application: Commit 4875ee5412fbe4a529b5bd73537ee09c89deb194, later merged by HL7/fhir#3557, updated Device.manufactureDate, Device.expirationDate, Device.lotNumber, and Device.serialNumber short descriptions to the proposed production-identifier wording. The PR/Jira note says biologicalSourceEvent had already been updated by a previous ticket, and current source contains production-identifier wording for that element as well.
additional_context: Device is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-47890 established biologicalSourceEvent as a key production identifier, and FHIR-54323 later revised that element's wording while preserving the production-identifier meaning. OO 2025-07-21 HCP minutes record a 5-0-0 motion to update FHIR-48769 descriptions as proposed. Direct Zulip search for FHIR-48769 found no conflicting implementation discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active Device StructureDefinition already conveys the requested production-identifier semantics, and changing biologicalSourceEvent to match the original FHIR-48769 table would undo later approved wording.
